parole.testo: Borrowed from Early Modern Spanish ojalá, from Arabic وَشَاءَ ٱلله (wašāʔa llāh, “and may God will it”) or لَوْ شَاءَ ٱلله (law šāʔa llāh, “if God wills it”). Compare English inshallah.

parole.significato: a teacup or mug (vessel with a handle for hot beverages)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Early Modern Spanish xícara, from Classical Nahuatl xīcalli.
